jobs.description: About CookUnity: Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. You will help teams understand both sides of CookUnity's marketplace: how customers find meals that fit their lives and how chef supply, variety, and merchandising shape that experience. You will own measurement and analysis for a product area, turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, and use evidence to guide product decisions. Our teams operate through clear success metrics, rapid learning, and controlled experiments. You will help them distinguish meaningful customer and business outcomes from activity, evaluate tradeoffs across the funnel and customer lifecycle, and make insights accessible in day-to-day decisions.
